create.name: Drikung Dharma Surya Center
create.bio:
Drikung Dharma Surya Center is a Drikung Kagyu Tibetan Buddhist temple on Ox Road in Fairfax, Northern Virginia, about half an hour west of Washington, D.C. It was founded by His Eminence Garchen Rinpoche, who gave it its name, meaning "sun of the Dharma", and the temple was consecrated in August 2015 by the Drikung Kyabgön Chetsang, with Garchen Rinpoche and Lamchen Gyalpo Rinpoche also taking part. Its spiritual director is Khenpo Samdup Rinpoche, and much of the daily practice is led by two resident nuns trained in India: Khenmo Konchok Tsechik and, alongside her, Lopön Konchok Gamtso. The shrine hall holds a thousand Buddha statues, with a large outdoor prayer wheel and a contemplation garden in the grounds.

From Tuesday to Friday the temple holds late-morning prayers and deity practice, and on Sundays it alternates an introductory Learning Buddhism class with guided mindfulness meditation, in person and on Zoom. Khenpo Samdup gives longer teaching series, such as a commentary on the Dzogchen text Flight of the Garuda, and the centre runs annual group retreats, including a December Guru Rinpoche recitation retreat. It keeps a large free library of practice texts, audio and video, and posts recordings of its teachings on its YouTube channel. The temple is open to visitors from Tuesday to Sunday.

courses.title: 9th Annual Guru Rinpoche Bhum Tsok
courses.description: A three-day group retreat guided by Khenpo Samdup Rinpoche and monastics from several traditions, opening with a transmission and teaching and then gathering a hundred thousand recitations of the prayers to Guru Rinpoche, Padmasambhava. Join in person in Fairfax or on Zoom; registration by email.

free_resources.title: Weekly programme: Learning Buddhism and guided mindfulness meditation
free_resources.description: Sunday afternoon sessions at the temple and on Zoom that alternate an introductory class on Buddhism with guided mindfulness meditation, alongside weekday prayers and deity practice with the resident nuns.

free_resources.title: Text library of sadhanas and teachings
free_resources.description: A large free collection of practice texts and teaching transcripts in English, Tibetan, Chinese, Spanish and Vietnamese, from daily prayers and Chenrezig practice to commentaries by Khenpo Samdup Rinpoche.
